points.description: States that a C++ program begins execution at the main function (accept 'main', 'main()', 'the main function', 'entry point is main', or equivalent wording such as 'execution starts at main'). Do not accept vague answers such as 'the first line of the program', 'the first function defined', or 'the beginning of the file'.

rubric.notes: Full marks are earned only by naming the main function (main/main()) as the place where execution begins. Vague answers about the first line or first function do not earn marks. No part marks are available because the model answer contains a single fact.
